judgment.notes: M006 is used exactly once with V=ℝ, the explicitly zero-extended energy f:ℝ→ℝ, f₁=0, α=s, β=t, L=0 and y=t. The standard real normed-space structures satisfy its structural premises. Under L1 every r∈[s,t] is positive; F001 supplies its ordinary zero derivative, and BG006–BG007 justify extension locality and restriction, including endpoints. The bound on [s,t) is |0|=0 and t∈[s,t]. Its conclusion is exactly |E(t)−E(s)|≤0, hence equality. This checks the conditional application, not M006's separately owned source fidelity. No E applications occur.

At arbitrary t0>0, N003 identifies the derivative of the actual finite energy with ∫et. In N002 take τ=t0, so t0∈(τ/2,3τ/2); its density formula and integrable scalar sections apply. Finite integral linearity and scalar multiplication are checked in BG001–BG004. Replacing each spatial integral by N004 yields the minus sign displayed. Expanding the Euclidean dot product into its finite coordinate sum and D004's finite Laplacian gives ut·utt−Σj ut·∂j dxu(j)=ut·(utt−lap). N001 makes this identically zero and BG005 evaluates its integral. There is no extra differentiation or limit exchange. S002 then validly applies M006 with the zero derivative and obtains equality; equal or reversed positive times cover all cases. The factor 2 and energy normalization are preserved. Empty sums (n=0), trivial codomain (m=0), and the excluded time-zero endpoint introduce no exceptional step.

Every direct input has an actual role: N001 supplies the final orthogonality identity; N002 supplies integrability and the density derivative formula; N003 supplies energy differentiability and its integral derivative; N004 supplies the individual spatial integration-by-parts equalities; M006 supplies the zero-derivative constancy estimate. Only the second conjunct of N001 is needed; unused conjuncts do not make the input unused. The omitted routine integration algebra, its integrability closure, zero-integral evaluation, and derivative locality/restriction are positively checked in seven saved background notes BG001–BG007. No original H, additional project result, or unregistered substantive analytic tool is imported.

Reverse tracing the prose: energy/density regularity and integrability come from N002–N003; the density expansion comes from N002; the integrated spatial replacements come from N004; the pointwise cancellation comes from N001. Finite-coordinate dot-product distributivity and Laplacian unfolding use D004 and finite algebra. BG001–BG005 cover the ordinary integral facts not granted by finite-language-3. The only earlier local fact used in S002 is the fully quantified F001 produced by S001; BG006–BG007 justify the derivative restriction/extension. M006 then supplies the sole constancy theorem. Order cases and equality symmetry are elementary. No unavailable ancestor body or implied ambient PDE hypothesis is used.

N001–N004 and M006 are precisely the five direct conditional premises supplied. Each is instantiated with the packet's same u, n, m and derivatives. N001, N003 and N004 are specialized to t0>0 (and 1≤j≤n where needed). N002's more precise section-integrability assertion applies with τ=t0 and r=t0 in int J, in addition to its unconditional e-integrability clause. The guard N002 for the finite energy is directly available and supplies all positive-time section integrability before E is used. t0 is introduced arbitrary positive in S001; x and j are integration and finite-sum binders. The zero extension is explicitly defined there by cases using E only at positive arguments; f₁=0 and the source parameters are explicitly supplied by the application bindings.
